# i-mux's layouts: a sidebar (-h -b -f -l 30), agent splits, kill in the middle, resize, swap,
# zoom, save and restore.
new 200x50
split %0 -h -b -f -l 30
split %0 -h
split %2 -v
split %0 -v
select %0
kill %4
resize %1 -x 40
resize %2 -L 7
resize %3 -U 4
resize %0 -R 3
resize %0 -D 2
swap %0 %3
swap %2 %1 -d
zoom %3
window 150x40
zoom %3
window 220x60
layout $10
layout v1$4
layout $8
kill %1
split %3 -h -f -l 25
layout $22
